target_customer: B2B SaaS sales teams and their managers
problem: Call recording tools capture conversations but do not show whether reps follow the sales playbook, so managers cannot coach consistently.

founders.name: Andreea Francis
founders.background_notes: Per YC company page; technical flag inferred from the product and growth roles listed, treat as uncertain.

competitors.name: Chorus
competitors.what: Conversation intelligence that records and analyses sales calls
competitors.traction_then: Acquired by ZoomInfo in 2021 per ZoomInfo comparison pages

technical_complexity.rationale: Transcription, scoring against frameworks such as MEDDIC and coaching summaries were achievable with speech APIs and language models, with some hard parts in accuracy.

defensibility.rationale: Positioned against generic note takers, but incumbents with call data could add playbook scoring easily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The company still sells independently per its site; no source shows an incumbent copying or buying it.

market_need_then: Sales organisations already paid for call recording, and the company site says adoption of playbooks is the gap that managers need to see.

identity.voice_and_tone: Contrastive headline: Go beyond call recording, not just another AI note taker

branding.community_and_virality: No community or press about the brand was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Pleasant, easy name but no evidence of brand-driven awareness; one search for name origin returned nothing relevant.

outcome_analysis: SilkChart came through YC in 2022 with an AI sales assistant focused on playbook adoption and reports a seed around five million dollars in December 2022 with SoftBank, Harlem Capital and others. It is still active with about eight people, and its site shows startup logos such as Ramp and Rippling but does not say they pay. Revenue and later rounds are not public.
notes: Seed of $5.2M on 7 Dec 2022 comes from CB Insights, VCBacked, FundedIQ and Seedtable, all aggregators with no primary announcement; the company site confirms YC, SoftBank, GFC, Harlem Capital and Dentsu as backers. Totals conflict ($5.2M to $5.7M) and a Kando entry shows a $125K June 2022 seed, unverified. Batch is Summer 2022 per the dataset though one source says W22. An unverified aggregator snippet names Matthew Rajcok as co-founder; not recorded as a founder. Gong is the obvious rival but no dated pre-batch source was found. Founded year not found.
